provenance: PROVISIONAL Factory-side fixture. Issue #12 (LAB) owns candidate generation. The verdicts are NOT authored here -- every pass and fail is computed by tools/factory/checks.py from measured geometry, and the rejections were found by sweeping every fastener against every longer stock length on this assembly, not designed to fail.
goal: Stiffen the NeoRacer steering link without disturbing a purchased interface.

candidates.label: Baseline NeoRacer full vehicle as published
candidates.rationale: The unmodified assembly. It must pass the same check set as every candidate.

candidates.label: Steering link +1.0 mm, clamping screws lengthened in place
candidates.rationale: Stiffen the steering link and carry the extra millimetre of grip into exactly the four screw occurrences that pass through it.

candidates.label: Steering link +0.5 mm, same scoped substitution
candidates.rationale: A lighter variant of the same idea; the same fastener step more than covers the smaller grip growth.

candidates.label: Steering link +2.0 mm, fastener schedule untouched
candidates.rationale: The cheapest version: change one part and leave the hardware alone, assuming 2 mm is too small to matter.

candidates.label: Standardise the short steering screws at 12 mm
candidates.rationale: Cut the fastener schedule: this assembly carries M3 cap screws at four different lengths. Run one longer M3 and drop a part number, gaining engagement everywhere. Applied at the definition, so it reaches every occurrence.

candidates.label: Widen the differential bearing by 1.0 mm
candidates.rationale: Use a beefier bearing to take more load through the differential.
